note: Town of Vulcan municipal campground, a short walk to town; playground. Only 16 sites may be used for stays longer than 14 days. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 32 full-service 30 A sites, C$35 nightly (weekly C$210, monthly C$875), no reservations/first-come, phone 403-485-2417. Wrote season May 1 - Sep 30 (manual), booking (FCFS, kiosk), fees (manual with weekly/monthly), hookups, sites, showers; note rewritten. Flush toilets and dump not stated on the page (left derived).
flags: NOT IN DB: the same page describes a second, separate town campground - 'Vulcan Municipal Campground (Free Campground 1st Avenue South) By the Arena, Corner of Highway 534 & 1st Ave South', 'No Reservations', 'Water and sewage disposal available', free for up to 3 consecutive nights in six months, then C$20 a night, max 14 consecutive days (Policy PU-06). No entry within 3 km of Vulcan other than 9021. A lead for a curator to vet (it is a different place by the arena, not a split of this campground).

FACILITIES: the page says 'Shower/Washroom facilities are available' but does not name flush toilets or a dump station; the stored derived flush_toilets and dump were left as they are (not contradicted). Policy PU-05 is silent on them too.

LONG STAY: PU-05 '2.1 Only 16 stalls may be used for stays longer than 14 days' and weekly/monthly rates are posted - an ordinary municipal campground with a posted nightly rate and first-come sites; no concern.
PHONE: 403-485-2417 (stored) is the Town office on the page ('321 - 2nd Street South 403-485-2417') - confirmed. WEBSITE: the stored page answered 200.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - confirmed): on Esri imagery the two rows of sites sit in open grass between ball diamonds and an industrial yard; no water nearby.

PIN (50.40600,-113.26990): at the west end of the two site rows (row centre about 50.4061,-113.2694, ~40 m away) - no move. Google's 'Virginia Mitchell Playground' 50.40553,-113.26782 is the playground SE of the rows.
